name: LandTrendr
summary: Year of detection, magnitude, duration and rate of the chosen loss or gain event.

name: Recovery
summary: After LandTrendr's loss: years to recovery (Y2R), R80P, RRI and the absolute and year-on-year recovery.

name: EWMACD
summary: Every observation against its training years through EWMA control charts: when it was disturbed, how far, when it recovered or gained, its state now.

name: Emerging hot spots
summary: Where values cluster high or low and how that changed: the Getis-Ord Gi* of every date and its trend, as ESRI's patterns (new, intensifying, persistent, sporadic... hot and cold spots).

name: Mann-Kendall
summary: Significant Sen's slope, p-value and trend class, with Hamed-Rao, Yue-Wang and seasonal variants.

name: AR(1) trend
summary: The trend's t-test with autocorrelated errors (remotePARTS), and the regional Trend test by PARTS.

name: BFAST
summary: Trend and season break counts, date and magnitude of the largest break.

name: BFAST Lite
summary: Break count, date and magnitude of the largest break, first break date.

name: BFAST Monitor
summary: First break in the monitoring period, its magnitude, break yes or no.

name: BEAST
summary: Trend and season averaged over thousands of models: the probability of a changepoint at each date, the most probable one with its jump, the mean number of changepoints.

name: Phenology
summary: Start, peak and end of season, length, amplitude, for a typical year or a chosen one.

name: CCDC
summary: Break count, largest break, NDVI change and segments from every reflectance band.

name: S-CCD
summary: CCDC's models carried forward by a Kalman filter: the breaks, and the state of every pixel at the last date (stable, change in progress and since when, waiting for a model).

name: CODED
summary: Forest degradation and deforestation from the NDFI of every observation, as strata and change dates.

name: NDFI
summary: Spectral unmixing of every date into a new layer of the NDFI, ready for the other tools.

name: Spectral unmixing
summary: The fraction of each cover (vegetation, soil, water...) whose spectrum you take from pins, at every date or in a hyperspectral scene.

name: Tmask
summary: The clouds and shadows the quality band missed, and the series without them as a new layer.

name: TWDTW
summary: A class map from patterns you take from pins on places you know.

name: Post-processing
summary: A classification cleaned: one-year flickers removed, a majority filter and a minimum mapping unit; models' probabilities smoothed by Bayesian smoothing (Camara et al. 2024).

name: SOM
summary: Clusters of alike trajectories, with the typical series of the one under the cursor.

name: k-means
summary: Compact clusters of the whole series, named by the classes of your samples in them.

name: Agreement
summary: Where and when several change maps agree: the consensus year and how many back it.

name: Smoothing
summary: Whittaker and Savitzky-Golay, drawn over the series on the chart.

name: SNIC
summary: Segments of alike series, their mean series as a layer and their polygons as a vector layer.
